name: Libya

flag.description: Three horizontal stripes of red, black and green, the black stripe twice as tall as the others, with a white crescent and five-pointed star in the centre.
flag.symbolism: The stripes recall the historic regions of Fezzan (red), Cyrenaica (black) and Tripolitania (green); the crescent and star represent Islam.

hook: Libya's broad black middle band carries a white crescent and star between thin red and green stripes.
trivia: The flag was first used under the monarchy from 1951 and readopted in 2011, replacing the plain green flag used from 1977.
From 1977 to 2011 Libya's plain green flag was the only national flag with a single colour and no design.
